action_health.note: Necessary frozen action-health gate only; variability does not prove useful state response or performance benefit.

all_input_csv_rows.cost_definition: User+system only, summed over persistent inventoried run-owned PIDs; children_user/system excluded to avoid double counting. One core=100%. Inventory field states whether orphaned Mahimahi was captured; not CPU attributable solely to inference.
all_input_csv_rows.cost_host_cpu_scope: Whole host average across cores for final monitoring interval; includes asynchronous kernel/network and controller overhead. Excludes idle, iowait, steal and duplicate guest.
all_input_csv_rows.cost_resource_inventory: v2 exact run-path plus descendants, including reparented Mahimahi
all_input_csv_rows.cpu_statistics_window: Prespecified steady monitor endpoints near25..50s; separate from full/trim10 network windows
all_input_csv_rows.joint_statistics_window: Whole controlled exposure; startup discovery excluded. Network windows full60/trim10.
all_input_csv_rows.training_run: Single optimizer-variable pair; reused completed legacy, three unstarted arms only. Independently trained five fixed periods; original56 coverage. Twelve development cases, one prior seed ancestry. Expanded coverage not trained; no publication success claim.

interpretation: Two evaluation repeats and one training-seed ancestry; means/ranges and paired differences are descriptive, not significance or a paper PASS.
Five fixed20/40/80/120/160 policies were independently trained window controllers using the V31 legacy shared Adam; this is not a same-weight period override.
V34 independent versus V34 legacy is the registered optimizer comparison; the independent-Adam candidate versus the fixed grid is not a timing-only causal experiment.
Current training coverage is original56. Six new preregistered cases are development screening, not matched expanded training or blind final testing.
Necessary dual-action gate applies to dynamic adaptive conditions. Constant steady timing is reported separately; fixed-period and rule arms do not receive a dual-action gate.
Performance gate uses trim10 per-scene replicate means; repeat gates and full windows are retained. No CPU advantage compensates a network gate failure.
Pareto uses utilization (higher) and mean/P95/P99/drop fraction (lower). Loss denominator is the input evaluator definition; no unobserved loss data are invented.

CPU uses recorded owned user+system monitoring endpoints (typically25..50s), one core=100%, including Mahimahi; calls use whole actual controlled exposure, separate from network full/trim10. Native-rule Python CPU is evaluator/launcher overhead, not inference; actual whole-run CPU is retained.
No pure-RL baseline is present. Top-tier means only relative to measured eligible opponents; it is not global optimality or publication success.
Missing/failed observations remain null/UNKNOWN and are retained. No condition or checkpoint is selected using these analysis results.
